claim_text: Netanyahu said Israel had entered Iran twice to save Israel from atomic bombs that were already in Iran's hands, asserting actual Iranian possession of atomic bombs.
discovery_sources: Benjamin Netanyahu official YouTube full Patriots interview; Ynet; Times of Israel; Reuters; ODNI; IAEA
resolution_notes: Accepted as False / High confidence. Exact wording is preserved by independent reporting and the original full interview container. Public U.S. intelligence shortly before the claim still assessed Iran was months from being able to build a nuclear weapon; earlier ODNI assessment said Iran was not building one. Verdict is limited to literal possession of assembled atomic bombs and preserves Iran's enriched-uranium capability, safeguards concerns and verification uncertainty. Origin remains Guest / interviewee, not Channel 14 editorial speech.
